title: Veeva CRM Object Inventory — Standard Objects by Module
summary: The Veeva CRM data model includes approximately 80+ standard custom objects, all carrying the _vod suffix. These objects are organized by functional module and represent the core data structures for pharmaceutical commercial operations.

call_management.description: Objects supporting field rep call reporting, scheduling, and activity tracking against HCPs and HCOs.
call_management.key_objects: Call report header and detail objects, call objectives, pre-call planning records.

sample_management.description: Objects handling sample inventory, distribution, lot tracking, reconciliation, and regulatory compliance.
sample_management.key_objects: Sample lot, sample transaction, sample inventory, sample receipt, cold chain record, and signature capture objects.

approved_email.description: Objects managing the creation, approval, and distribution of compliant email communications to HCPs.
approved_email.key_objects: Approved email template, email fragment, sent email record, content module, and template fragment junction objects.

clm_content.description: Objects supporting Closed Loop Marketing — digital content presentations during in-person HCP interactions.
clm_content.key_objects: Presentation, key message, slide, content interaction, and media tracking objects.

consent_management.description: Objects tracking HCP communication preferences, opt-in/opt-out status, and regulatory consent across channels.
consent_management.key_objects: Consent header, consent line, consent type, channel consent, and multichannel consent objects.

territory_management.description: Objects defining sales territory hierarchies, account-territory assignments, and alignment rules.
territory_management.key_objects: Territory, territory-to-account association, alignment rule, and zip-territory mapping objects.

events_management.description: Objects supporting speaker programs, medical education events, attendee tracking, and event budgets.
events_management.key_objects: Event header, event attendee, speaker contract, event budget, and event material objects.

coaching_and_training.description: Objects for field manager coaching activities, ride-along assessments, and competency tracking.
coaching_and_training.key_objects: Coaching report, coaching objective, assessment score, and development plan objects.

medical_and_msl.description: Objects supporting Medical Science Liaison workflows, including scientific exchange tracking and medical inquiry management.
medical_and_msl.key_objects: Medical inquiry, scientific discussion, publication reference, and medical event objects.

naming_convention: All Veeva standard objects use the _vod suffix (e.g., Call2_vod__c, Sample_Transaction_vod__c). Custom fields also carry the _vod suffix.
migration_relevance: The object inventory is the starting point for any migration assessment. Each module must be evaluated for data volume, field-level mapping, automation dependencies, and relationship integrity.

title: Veeva CRM Field Taxonomy and Security Model
summary: Veeva CRM fields follow a structured taxonomy with the _vod suffix convention and fall into distinct functional categories.

system_fields.description: Fields managed by Veeva platform logic — auto-populated timestamps, calculated status fields, system-generated identifiers.
system_fields.migration_note: Often replaced by equivalent platform capabilities on the target system.

configuration_fields.description: Fields that control application behavior — picklist values, checkbox flags, formula fields, reference fields.
configuration_fields.migration_note: Configuration fields require functional analysis, not just data migration.

data_fields.description: Fields storing user-entered or integration-sourced business data — text, dates, numbers, lookups.
data_fields.migration_note: Most straightforward to migrate. Primary concerns: data type compatibility and referential integrity.

formula_fields.description: Calculated fields that derive values from other fields. May reference Veeva-specific functions.
formula_fields.migration_note: Must be re-implemented on the target platform using equivalent formula syntax.

field_level_security.model: Uses Salesforce standard FLS model — visibility and editability per profile or permission set.
field_level_security.veeva_specifics: Veeva adds dynamic layout rules controlling field visibility based on record type, user role, or other field values.
field_level_security.sharing_model: Record-level access follows Salesforce OWD + sharing rules + role hierarchy. Veeva territory-based sharing adds complexity.

relationship_patterns.lookup_relationships: Standard lookup relationships — flexible, nullable references.
relationship_patterns.master_detail_relationships: Tight parent-child with cascading delete and roll-up summary support.
relationship_patterns.polymorphic_lookups: Fields referencing multiple object types — used sparingly.

title: Veeva CRM Object Relationship Patterns and Salesforce Platform Dependencies
summary: Veeva CRM is built on the Salesforce platform, creating a layered architecture where Veeva custom objects coexist with standard Salesforce objects.

salesforce_standard_object_dependencies.account: Veeva uses standard Account for HCP and HCO records, adding custom fields and record types.
salesforce_standard_object_dependencies.contact: Standard Contact for stakeholder tracking with custom fields for credentials and specialty.
salesforce_standard_object_dependencies.user: User object drives territory assignments, sample limits, coaching hierarchies.
salesforce_standard_object_dependencies.task_and_event: Standard activity objects used alongside Veeva custom call reporting object.

tsf_model.description: Territory/Stakeholder Framework defines field rep-to-territory-to-account assignments.
tsf_model.components: Territory hierarchy, territory-to-user assignments, account-to-territory alignments, stakeholder access records.
tsf_model.migration_complexity: One of the most complex migration areas — interacts with sharing rules, role hierarchy, and Veeva custom visibility logic.

cross_module_relationships.call_to_sample: Call reports reference sample transactions for cross-module traceability.
cross_module_relationships.call_to_content: CLM interactions linked to call reports.
cross_module_relationships.consent_to_email: Consent records gate approved email functionality.
cross_module_relationships.territory_to_everything: Territory assignments influence visibility across all modules.
